recentItems.title: Rahul Gandhi's US Tour Faces BJP Heat, Student Protests & India's Democracy Take Centre Stage
recentItems.description:
Rahul Gandhi will visit the United States from November 16 to 19, with two key engagements planned at Columbia University and the University of Chicago. He is expected to participate in fireside chats on student movements, global geopolitics and Indian democracy. Sam Pitroda has confirmed the engagements, while the BJP has questioned the timing of the visit and demanded greater transparency.
